CustomField.description: For a question on the 0 to 10 scale: the share of answers at 9 or 10 minus the share at 0 to 6, from -100 to 100. Blank for any other question.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: On a 0 to 10 question, the share answering 9 or 10 minus the share answering 0 to 6. It runs from -100 to 100.
CustomField.label: Net Promoter Score
